Catalog number : I00037 Uniform title: Śaktimaṇṭapapūjā Manuscript : IFP manuscript bundle RE10781 Description: RE10781 The manuscript primarily focuses on the Śaktimaṇṭapapūjā, which includes elaborate rituals such as the Caturdvārāpūjā (worship of the four ways that is doors), Maṇṭapapūjā, Vedikārcanam (worship of the altar), and various Āvaraṇapūjās dedicated to Goddess Devī. It also details the Dūtikānyāsa, Devīśrīkaṇṭhanyāsa, and an incomplete section on Devīṣaḍadhvanyāsa. These rituals are integral to invoking and venerating the divine energy of Devī.The bundle contains 62 folios, and there are 5 lines in each folio. This manuscript provides a rich insight into the esoteric and ritualistic practices of Devī (Goddess) worship, reflecting the depth and precision of tantric traditions in the Śaivāgamic framework. It is a valuable resource for understanding the layered structure of Devīnyāsa and Pūjā procedures. (p.3a, f.a) saktimantapapūjā - śaktimaṇṭapapūjā (p.3b, f.b) śrī gurubhyo namaḥ hariḥ oṃ śaktimaṇṭapapūjai kailāsanātheśvarāya namaḥ nyāsam (p.4a, f.a) blank page (p.4b, f.b) blank page (p.5a, f.a) blank page
(p.5b, f.1a) śaktimaṇṭapapūjā
(l.1) gaṇdhabhṛvānmadāyaktābhramarākulitānanaḥ । śivāgamārttha siddhyarthaṃ vandehaṃ gaṇanāyakam ॥ atha śaktiyāgapūjāvidhirucyate । (l.2) maṇṭapa kuṇḍañcedi toraṇabhṛtbhṛva taraṅga muktādāmādibhiḥ । kartāśraddhādibhiḥ yāgasadanamalaṃkṛtyāvedi madhye vidhivat śāli - (l.3) - taṇḍula tila lājairaṣṭapatramālikhya pradhānavarddhanīṃ vidyeśvaravarddhanīṃ parivāravarddhanīṃ ca lakṣaṇoktavat । (l.4) dvitabhu tritabhubhiḥ tila yavādyantarāṇi.yaṃ vedya - tasyakṣaḻanānantaraṃ dhūpa itvāslilaraktaṃ tu rcāmmra patra nāḻikera navavastra gandhadravyairalaṅkṛtya (l.5) pūrvādidīśānāntaṃ parivāra varddhanīśca saṃsthāpya guruḥ pādau prakṣāḻya ācamya mahāśānti gaṇeśaṃ ca brāhmī bhānu maheśvarī (l.6) skando vidyā mahāśāstā kaumārī vāstu nāyakīḥ । vaiṣṇavī ca ramā caiva vṛṣabhaṃ ca nivṛttikā - vīrabhadraṃ ca varāhi māyā māhendrikā tathā ।
(p.6a, f.1b, l.1) mohinī kṣetrapālaśca pratiṣṭhācca tathaiva ca । caṇḍeśvarī ca cāmuṇḍī astramastreśvarī tathā । gurudurgā bhāratī ca gaurī yāgeprakīrttitāḥ । (l.2) bhānu śāntimadadanti vidyāskandaṃ ca śāstṛkā । pratiṣṭhākṣetra caṇḍeśi nivṛtti vṛṣabhastathā । vīrabhadrāvidhirmāyā brāhmī māheśvarī picā । kaumārī vaiṣṇavi grauṣṭi māhendri caṇḍidurgikā । (l.3) bhārati lakṣmī mohinyā gurumūrttistathaiva ca । sūryādi guruparyantaṃ sarvāndevā prapūjayet । (l.4) yāgaśālāyāṃ paścimadvāreṇāntaḥ praviśya deśiko navavastradūkūla gandhapuṣpākṣitārṣṇiṣa makara kuṇḍalahārakeyūra kaṭi sūtra hema (l.5) yajñopavītāṃ guri.... bhaskarudrākṣa mālādibhiralaṃkṛtya । niṛṛte deśa māsādya gaṇapatiṃ saṃpūjya saṃkalpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ।
(p.6b, f.2a, l.1) sarvatraprokṣayet śuciḥ । śakrānaladiśormadhye nityavat śivasūtyamabhyarcya । oṃ hāṃ arkāsanāya namaḥ oṃ khaṃ khaṣolkāya śivasūryamūrttaye namaḥ (l.2) dhyānaṃ - bhānuṃ kuṅkumabhāsvara dvinayanañcekānanaṃ padmakaṃ । savyetāmarasābhaye ca dadhataṃ (l.3) vāmekarebjaṃ .......prayuktaṃ pratyuṣayā ca vā magatathādhabhesthadhā śobhayā - dhyāyedrakta sagandhamālyavasanaṃ bhāsva prabhāmaṇḍalam । (l.4) oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ śivasūryāya namaḥ gandha puṣpa dhūpadīpanaivedyādibhiḥ saṃpūjya - guruḥ pādau hastau ca prakṣāḻya - vidhivat bhasmadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā (l.5) sāmānyārghyaṃ saṃkalpya pūrvadvāratoraṇamastreṇa saṃprokṣya kavacenāvakuṇṭhya - toraṇamadhye - oṃ hāṃ śāntitoraṇāya namaḥ - (l.6) nīlavastrāṅgarāgaṃ ca dvibhujāñjali padmakam । karāḻavadanaṃ śyāmaṃ ddhyāyedvaiśāntitoraṇam ॥ oṃ hāṃ śāntitoraṇāya namaḥ -
(p.7a, f.2b, l.1) śāntitoraṇādhipataye oṃ hrīṃ bhadrāya namaḥ - ūrdhve - śyāmavarṇa dvinetraṃ ca ekavaktraṃ caturbhujam । (l.2) daṇḍākṣamāleṛgvedamañjali dadhatannamaḥ ॥ oṃ hrīṃ ṛgvedāya namaḥ oṃ kṛtayugāya namaḥ triśuleṣu oṃ gaṅgāya namaḥ oṃ yamunāya namaḥ oṃ narmadāyai namaḥ । (l.3) uttaradakṣiṇaśākhayoḥ - oṃ indrāya namaḥ - oṃ hrīṃ śacīdevyai namaḥ । oṃ agnaye namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ svāhādevyai namaḥ uttaraśākhāmūle (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ bhūrllokāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ pratyuṣāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ somāya namaḥ dakṣiṇaśākhāmūle । oṃ hrīṃ bhuvarlokāya namaḥ (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ prabhāsāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ bhaumāya namaḥ । dvārottaravarddhanyāṃ । caturvaktraṃ caturbāhu śuklavarṇa mahābalā । ddhvajābhajākṣamālābja śāntissarvopavītinīm ॥ (l.6) oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ śāntikalādvārāya namaḥ । ūrdhvodumbarottaradakṣiṇabhāgeṣu - oṃ hrīṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ
(p.7b, f.3a, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ । śānti uttarakumbhe - ekavaktraṃ dvinetraṃ ca karaṇḍamakuṭānvitam । nīlajīmūtavarṇābhāṃ śāntiṃvyajanadhāriṇam । (l.2) vāyasaṃ vāhanaṃ caivacchāyā putraṃ tu bhāvayet ॥ oṃ hrīṃ śanaiścarāya namaḥ dvāradakṣiṇakumbhe । (l.3) gajānanaṃ triṇetraṃ tu śyāmavarṇaṃ caturbhujam । laḍḍukaṃ paraśuṃ vāme saye dantākṣa mālikā । nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ॥ oṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ । (l.4) naivedya dhūpadīpau datvā । dvārottara patākāyām । praśānto raktavarṇaśca dvibhujaśca dvilocanaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇa bhūṣitaḥ ॥ (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ praśāntāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇapatākāyām śiśiroraktavarṇaśca dvibhuśca dvilocanaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇa bhūṣitaḥ ॥ (l.6) oṃ hrīṃ śiśirāya namaḥ । dvarordhvadhvaje kumudaṃ pūrvadikbhāge sitavarṇaṃ vibhāvayet । dvilocanaṃ dvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥
(p.8a, f.3b, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ kumudāya namaḥ । dvāre । oṃ hrīṃ astradvārapālyai namaḥ । oṃ hriṃ avargāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ kavargāya namaḥ (l.2) sarvebhyodvārapālebhyasvāhā ityarghyaṃdatvā - gandhapuṣpanaivedya dhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । bhavadbhiḥ yajñarakṣakatvena sthātavyaṃ (l.3) ahitādarairiti vijñāpya । agnikoṇadhvaje āgneyyāṃ kumudākṣaṃ ca diśibhānu samaprabham । dvilocanaṃ dvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥ (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ kumudākṣāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇadvāratoraṇamastreṇasaṃprokṣya । kavacenāvakuṇṭhya toraṇamadhye । (l.5) dvibhujaṃ ca dvinetraṃ ca kṛṣṇābharaṇabhūṣitam । bhūtitoraṇamākhyātaṃ sthūlagrīvammahodaram ॥ oṃ hrīṃ bhūtitoraṇāya namaḥ । bhūtitoraṇādhipataye vijayāya namaḥ । (l.6) raktavarṇaṃ dvinetraṃ ca śuklayajñopavītinam । sṛggaṇḍikāñjalībhūtaṃ yajurvedaṃ vibhāvayet ॥ oṃ hrīṃ yajurvedāya namaḥ
(p.8b, f.4a, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ tretāyugāya namaḥ । triśūleṣu oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ sindhave namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ godāvaryai namaḥ । (l.2) pūrvapaścimaśākhayoḥ । oṃ hrīṃ yamāya namaḥ । kāḻakaṇṭhyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ niṛṛtaye namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ jātāya namaḥ । pūrvaśākhāmūle (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ suvarlokāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ ajaghanyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ budhāyai namaḥ । paścimaśākhāmūle । oṃ hrīṃ maharlokāyai namaḥ । (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ jaghanyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ bṛhaspataye namaḥ । dvārapūrvakumbhe । raktavarṇakapardendutrivaktraṃ ca caturbhujam । śakhyābhajākṣamālābja vidyājvalanasannibhām ॥ (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ vidyākalādvārāya namaḥ । ūrdhvodumbare pūrvapaścimamadhyabhāgeṣu - oṃ hrīṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ । (l.6) oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ । vidyāpūrvakumbhe । vidrumaprabhamekamukhaṃ vibhuṃ vajraśaktivaradābhaya hastakam । (p.9a, f.4b, l.1) devalokaripughnamavighnadaṃ naumurudrabhavaṃ śikhivāhanaṃ bhaje ॥ oṃ hāṃ skandāya namaḥ । dvārasyapaścimakumbhe । āśyāmakomalaviśālatanuṃ vicitraṃ (l.2) vāsovasānamaruṇotpalavāmahastam । uttuṅgaratnamakuṭaṃ kuṭilāgraheśaṃ śāstāramiṣṭavadanaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ॥ (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ hariharaputrāya namaḥ । gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpadibhissaṃpūjya । dvārapūrvapatākāyām । (l.4) parjanyoraktavarṇaśca dvibhuśca dvilocanaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥ oṃ hrīṃ parjanyāya namaḥ । dvārapaścimapatākāyām । (l.5) jayantośvetavarṇaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ ca dvilocanaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥ oṃ hrīṃ jayantāya namaḥ । dvārordhvadhvaje । (l.6) bhṛṅgābhaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca dakṣiṇe tu vicintayet । dvilocanaṃ dvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥ oṃ hrīṃ puṇḍarīkāya namaḥ । (p.9b, f.5a, l.1) dvāra astradvārapālāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ cavargāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ ṭavargāya namaḥ । sarvebhyodvārapālebhyasvāhā ityarghyaṃ datvā (l.2) dhenumudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ pradarśya gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । bhavadbhiḥ yajñarakṣakatvena sthātavyaṃ āhitādarairiti vijñāpya । (l.3) niṛṛtikoṇadhvaje । vāmananniṛṛtedeśe bhinnāñjana samaprabham । dvilocanaṃ dvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥ (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ vāmanāyai namaḥ । uttaradvāratoraṇamastreṇasaṃprokṣya kavacenāvakuṇṭhya - toraṇamadhye । (l.5) dvibhujaṃ ca dvinetraṃ ca pārśvayorlambakeśanam । daṃṣṭrākarāḻavadanaṃ ārogyatoraṇaṃ yajet ॥ oṃ hrīṃ ārogyatoraṇāyai namaḥ । (l.6) ārogyatoraṇādhipataye oṃ hrīṃ nīlalohitāyai namaḥ । ūrdhve । śvetavarṇa dvinetraṃ ca hemayajñopavītinam । bṛhmāstragaṇḍikāyuktaṃ sāmavedaṃ kṛtāñjalīm ॥ (p.10a, f.5b, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ sāmavedāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ dvāparayugāya namaḥ । triśūleṣu । oṃ hrīṃ kāveryai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ godāvaryai namaḥ । (l.2) oṃ hrīṃ trivenyai namaḥ । paścimadvāraśākhayoḥ oṃ hrīṃ kāveryai namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ gambhinyai namaḥ । (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ īśānāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ harṣiṇyai namaḥ । paścimaśākhāmūle । oṃ hrīṃ janarlokāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ prabhañjanāyai namaḥ । (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ bhārgavāyai namaḥ । pūrvaśākhamūle । tapolokāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ pratāpāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ śanaiścarāya namaḥ । (l.5) dvārapaścimakumbhe । śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśadvivaktraṃ ca caturbhujam । pāśābhayākṣamālābjā pratiṣṭhāratnabhūṣitā ॥ oṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhākalādvārāyai namaḥ । (p.10b, f.6a, l.1) ūrdhvodumbare paścimapūrvamadhyabhāgeṣu - oṃ hrīṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ । (l.2) pratiṣṭhāpaścimakumbhe । indranīlaprakośaṃ krodharūpaṃ bhayānakam । daṃṣṭrābhamūrdhvakeśaṃ ca daṇḍahastaṃ ca śūlakam ॥ kapālānāgahastaṃ ca kṣetrapālasvarūpakam । (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ kṣetrapālāyai namaḥ । dvārapūrvakumbhe ॥ ekavaktraṃ dvinetraṃ ca karaṇḍamakuṭānvitam । utpalaṃ savyahaste tu varadaṃ vāmahastake ॥ (l.4) tāṭaṅkaṃ caiva karṇe tu sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam । lambitaṃ dakṣapādaṃ tu śayanaṃ vāmapādakam ॥ (l.5) gaurī sevā phalaṃ ghātrī caṇḍeśvarīmathācaret । oṃ hrīṃ caṇḍeśvaryai namaḥ । gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । (p.11a, f.6b, l.1) dvārapaścimapatākāyām । dhanadoraktavarṇaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ ca dvilocanaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥ oṃ hrīṃ dhanadāyai namaḥ । (l.2) dvārapūrvapatākāyām । śrīpradośvetavarṇaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ ca dvilocanaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥ (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ śrīpradāyai namaḥ । madhyadvaje । sumukhaṃ ṣaṭpadābhañca kuberadiśi saṃsthitam । (l.4) dvilocanaṃ dvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥ oṃ hrīṃ sumukhāyai namaḥ । dvāre । astrāyadvārapālāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ tavargāya namaḥ । (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ pavargāya namaḥ । sarvebhyodvārapālebhya svāhā । ityarghyaṃ datvā । dhenumudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ pradarśya । (l.6) gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । bhavadbhiḥ yajñasya rakṣakatvena sthātavyaṃ āhitādarairiti vijñāpya ।
(p.11b, f.7a, l.1) īśānakoṇadhvaje । īśānaṃ supratiṣṭhaṃ ca śaśāṅka dhavaḻaprabham । dvilocana dvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥ (l.2) oṃ hrīṃ supratiṣṭhāyai namaḥ । gandhapuṣpa dhūpadīpādibhissaṃpūjya । paścimadvāratoraṇamastraṇā saṃprokṣyā (l.3) saṃprokṣyakavacenāvakuṇṭhya - toraṇamadhye । raktavarṇadvinetraṃ ca nāgayajñopavītinam । kṛtāñjalipuṭopetaṃ dhyāyāmi balatoraṇam ॥ (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ balatoraṇāyai namaḥ balatoraṇādhipataye । oṃ hrīṃ vajrāyai namaḥ । ūrdhve । (l.5) kṛṣṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ tryaikṣaṃ kamaṇḍalvakṣasūtraṇīm । atharvaṇaṃ ca hastābhyāṃ añjalī dadhataṃ yajet ॥ oṃ hrīṃ atharvaṇavedāyai namaḥ ।
(p.12a, f.7b, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ kaliyugāyai namaḥ । triśūleṣu । oṃ hrīṃ śoṇabhadrāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ bhāgīrathyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ tuṅgabhadrāyai namaḥ । (l.2) dakṣiṇottaraśākhayoḥ । oṃ hrīṃ varuṇāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ bhoginyai namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ vāyavyai namaḥ । (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ ghoraśaktaye namaḥ । dakṣiṇaśākhāmūle । oṃ hrīṃ satyalokāyai namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ āvāhanāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ rāhave namaḥ । (l.4) uttaraśākhāmūle । oṃ hrīṃ dhṛvarlokāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ vivāhāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ ketave namaḥ । (l.5) paścimadvāradakṣiṇakumbhe । taptacāmīkarābhāsā ekavaktrendu bhūṣitaḥ । vajrābhayākṣamālābja nivṛttiparikīrttitā ॥
(p.12b, f.8a, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ nivṛttikalādvārāyai namaḥ । ūrdhvodumbare dakṣiṇottaramadhya bhāgeṣu - oṃ hrīṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ । (l.2) oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ । nivṛttidakṣiṇakumbhe । vṛṣabhaṃśvetavarṇaṃ tu tīkṣṇaśṛṅga mahābalam । saṃpuṭatathapādaṃ ekapādaṃ vahisthitam । (l.3) dharmadevākṛtirddhyātvā vāhanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā ॥ oṃ hrīṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ । dvārottarakumbhe । (l.4) raudraṃrudrāvatāraṃ hutavahanayanaṃ cordhvakeśaṃ sudaṃṣṭraṃ vyomāṅgaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ ghanaghana vilasat । ghaṇṭāmālāvṛtāṅgaṃ bhūtapretādhināthaṃ kṛtakanaka mayaṃ tuṅgapatre vahantaṃ । (l.5) vandelokaika vīraṃ bhuvanamatha śyāmalaṃ vīrabhadram ॥ oṃ viṃ vīrabhadrāya namaḥ । (l.6) gandhapuṣpa naivedya dhūpadīpādibhissaṃpūjya । dvāradakṣiṇapatākāyām । bhūtasañjīvanorakto dvibhuścadvilocanaḥ ।
(p.13a, f.8b, l.1) kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥ oṃ hrīṃ bhūtasañjīvanāya namaḥ । dvārottarapatākāyām । (l.2) amṛtaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ca dvibhuścadvilocanaḥ । kṛtāñjalipuṭāścaiva nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ॥ (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ amṛtasañjīvanāya namaḥ । dvārordhvadhvaje । vāruṇyaṃ śaṅkhukarṇaṃ ca diśinakṣatra sannibhaṃ । (l.4) dvilocanaṃdvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥ oṃ hrīṃ śaṅkhukarṇāya namaḥ । dvāre । astrāyadvārapālāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ yavargāya namaḥ । (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ ṣavargāya namaḥ sarvebhyodvārapālebhyasvāhā । ityarghyaṃ datvā । dhenumudrāṃ mahāmudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ pradarśyā । gandhapuṣpanaivedya dhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । (l.6) bhavadbhiḥ yajñasya rakṣakatvena sthātavyaṃ āhitādarairiti vijñāpya । vāyukoṇaddhvaje । sarpanetraṃ tu vāyavyaṃ tārādhipa samanvitam ।
(p.13b, f.9a, l.1) dvilocanaṃdvibāhuṃ ca daṇḍābhayakarānvitam ॥ oṃ hrīṃ sarpanetrāya namaḥ । gandhapuṣpa naivedya dhūpadīpādibhissaṃpūjyā । tadanu pūrvādīśānta dikṣu । (l.2) oṃ hrīṃ airāvatagajāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ puṇḍarīkagajāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ vāmanagajāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ kumudagajāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ añjaligajāya namaḥ । (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ puṣpadantagajāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ sārvabhaumagajāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ supratīka gajāya namaḥ । śvetavarṇadharā sarve dvinetraṃ ca mahābalaḥ । sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāḥ pūrvādīcāṣṭadiggajaḥ ॥ (l.4) itidhyātvā anantaraṃ pūrvādidikṣu oṃ hrīṃ hetukāmāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ tripuraghnānamaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ vahnaye namaḥ । (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ yamajihvāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ kālāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ karāline namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ ekāṅghryai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ bhīmāya namaḥ । (l.6) daṃṣṭrākarāḻavadanā sarvajñeyāmahodarākāsya khaṭvāṅga saṃyuktāḥ hetukādyā prakīrttitāḥ ॥ punaḥ pūrvādidikṣu । oṃ hrīṃ asitāṅgabhairavāya namaḥ ।
(p.14a, f.9b, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ rurubhairavāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ caṇḍabhairavāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ krodhabhairavāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ unmattabhairavāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ kapālabhairavāya namaḥ । (l.2) oṃ hrīṃ bhīṣaṇabhairavāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ saṃhārabhairavāya namaḥ । pūrvādi dīśānāntaṃ dvādaśastambheṣu । oṃ hrīṃ amṛtāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ mananāyai namaḥ । (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ puruṣāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ tuṣṭāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ puṣṭyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ ratyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ dhṛtyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ śaśinyai namaḥ । (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ candrīkāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ kāntyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ jyotsnāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ śrīyai namaḥ । āgneyādi catustambheṣu (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ vitaraṅgāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ pūrṇāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ pūrṇāmṛtāyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ kāmāyai namaḥ । tṛṇādyācchāte yāgagrahaṃ cet ॥ (l.6) kaṃpeṣu - oṃ hrīṃ prithivītattvāyai namaḥ । prithivītattvādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ sarasavatyai namaḥ । triṇeṣu oṃ hrīṃ jalatattvāya namaḥ ।
(p.14b, f.10a, l.1) jalatattvādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ । bandheṣu oṃ hrīṃ agnitattvāya namaḥ agnitattvādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ bhavānyai namaḥ । vaṃśeṣu (l.2) oṃ hrīṃ vāyutattvāya namaḥ vāyutattvādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ maheśvaryai namaḥ । sthūṇāsu oṃ hrīṃ ākāśatattvāya namaḥ ākāśatattvādhipāyai (l.3) oṃ hrīṃ manonmanyai namaḥ । itiśaktipadavyāptikam maṇḍapaṃ vibhāvya । cūlikāyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ śivāyai namaḥ । vitāneṣu oṃ hriṃ candrikāyai namaḥ । (l.4) taraṅgaṣu oṃ hrīṃ jāhnavyai namaḥ । darbhamālāyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ vāsukyai namaḥ । aṅkaṇeṣu oṃ hrīṃ mutgarāya namaḥ । (l.5) diśāsu oṃ hrīṃ astrāya namaḥ । tadanu । vāyukoṇadakṣiṇe । nagnarūpatrayakṣa caturbhujam । sarvapāśatriśūla kapālakam । ūrdhvakeśa ḍamarukaṃ (l.6) śvānakaṃ kṣetrapālasvarūpa nirūpaṇam । oṃ hāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ । itisaṃpūjyā anyānidvārāṇyastreṇa saṅghaṭya nityavat dvārapālān ।
(p.15a, f.10b, l.1) paścimadvāre..bhi saṃpūjya । atha gaurī pūjārtthaṃ sāmānyārghyaṃ astreṇa saṃprokṣya । pūrvadvārasthaṭiṇapatiṃ (l.2) saṃpūjya । tadantaraṃ dvārapālaśaktiṃ prapūjayet । dvārasya savyapārśve jayāñca raktavarṇābhāṃ dvinetrābhīmavigrahāṃ । (l.3) vāme tu kuñjitāṅghrī ca savye tu rujusaṃsthitām । savye tu khaṭgadhāriṇyāṃ vāmekheṭaka saṃyutām । (l.4) ugradaṣṭṛ samāyuktāṃ khaṭga kheṭaka dhāriṇīm । savye tu kuñjitāṅghrī ca vāme ruju saṃsthitām । sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ dvāravāmasthitaṃ bhaje ॥ oṃ hrīṃ vijayāyai namaḥ । (l.5) tayorājñeyā dvārapūjāsamārabhet । ūrdhvodumbare dakṣiṇottara madhyabhāgeṣu oṃ hrīṃ nirmadāyai namaḥ ।
(p.15b, f.11a, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyainamaḥ । dvārasya dakṣiṇaśākhāyām । oṃ hrīṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ । tasyavāme । (l.2) oṃ hrīṃ śivayoginyai namaḥ । dvārasya vāmaśākhāyām । oṃ hrīṃ yamunāyai namaḥ । tasyadakṣiṇe । oṃ hrīṃ bhūtinyai namaḥ । (l.3) ūrdhvadehaḻyām oṃ hrīṃ pataṅginyai namaḥ । adhodehaḻyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ bhuvaṅginyai namaḥ । dakṣiṇaśākhāyām । oṃ hrīṃ vegavatyai namaḥ । (l.4) vāmaśākhāyām oṃ hrīṃ godāvaryai namaḥ । savyakavāṭe oṃ hrīṃ sindhave namaḥ । vāmakavāṭe oṃ hrīṃ kāveryai namaḥ । (l.5) paṭṭikāsu oṃ skandāya namaḥ । valayoḥ oṃ sūryāya namaḥ oṃ candrāya namaḥ । suṣire navaśaktibhyo namaḥ । ādhāre oṃ haḥ astrāya namaḥ । (l.6) dvārāgre oṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ sarvebhyo dvārapālebhyosvāhā ityarghyaṃ datvā । bhūmau oṃ hrīṃ vighnādhyakṣāyai namaḥ
(p.16a, f.11b, l.1) huṃ phaḍāntāstreṇa savyapārṣṇitrighātena bhūmiṣṭha vighnānnirasya - antarikṣe । oṃ vighnarājāya namaḥ oṃ haḥ astrāya namaḥ । (l.2) iti mantreṇa tarjarāṅguṣṭhapuṣpakṣepeṇa antarikṣavighnānnirasya - svarge oṃ vighneśvarāya namaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ gauryai namaḥ । (l.3) iti mantreṇa aṅguṣṭhānāmikānyastamūlena cakṣuṣā svarge vighnānnirasya - rakṣāmeṣāṃ vijñāpya astreṇa (l.4) ghaṇṭāravena sahakiñcidvāmaśākhā samāśrayan dakṣiṇapādapurassaramanta praveśya । adhodehaḻyāṃ kalpāntāni prabhañjāstra adhodumbarakaṃ bhajet । (l.5) divyāntarikṣabhūmiṣṭhepi tannivāraṇārtthaṃ oṃ hrīṃ astraśaktyai namaḥ । tadanu upavedya paritaḥ pūrvādyaṣṭamaṅgaḻeṣu । (l.6) ūrvaśī dhṛta śrīvatse oṃ hrīṃ śrīvatsāyai namaḥ śrīvatsādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ umādevyai namaḥ । menakādhṛtakarake
(p.16b, f.12a, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ karakāyai namaḥ karakādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । rambhādhṛta kamale oṃ hrīṃ kamalāyai namaḥ kamādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ devyai namaḥ । (l.2) tilottamādhṛtadarpaṇe oṃ hrīṃ darpaṇāyai namaḥ darpāṇādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ kāveryai namaḥ । (l.3) sumukhidhṛta patāke oṃ hrīṃ patākāyai namaḥ patākādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ śrīdevyai namaḥ sundarīdhṛta svastike (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ svastikāyai namaḥ svastikādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ bhadrāyai namaḥ । kāmukhīdhṛtaśaṅkhe oṃ hrīṃ śaṅkhāyai namaḥ (l.5) śaṅkhādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ śacidevyai namaḥ । kāmavarddhanīdhṛtadīpe oṃ hrīṃ dīpāyai namaḥ dīpādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ gauryai namaḥ ।
(p.17a, f.12b, l.1) itisaṃpūjyā - tadanu vedikā dakṣiṇataḥ । kūrmāsane । vyāghrādinādau rucirāsane । udanmukhopaviśya- prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ (l.2) bhūtaśuddhiṃ gaurīkalānnyāsaṃ antaryajanasthānaśuddhiṃ mantraśuddhiṃ viśeṣārghyadravyaśuddhiṃ vidhāya । ātmapūjāṃ kṛtvā - (l.3) asmin lalāṭe oṃ huṃ śivatattvāya namaḥ śivatattvādhipāyai oṃ hrūṃ icchāśaktyai namaḥ । kaṇṭhe hīṃ vidyātattvāya namaḥ (l.4) vidyātattvādhipāyai oṃ hrīṃ jñānaśaktyai namaḥ । pādayoḥ oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvāya namaḥ ātmatattvādhipāyai oṃ hrāṃ kriyāśaktyai namaḥ (l.5) evaṃ vinyasya punaḥ sakaḻīkṛtya tatovihitāntaryajana havana tālatriyādīnadehaṃ saṃrakṣya viśeṣārghyaṃ saṃkalpyā-
(p.17b, f.13a, l.1) tajjalaṃ svaśirasi samprokṣya sakuśena yāgopakaraṇadravyajātamastreṇasamprokṣya kavacenābhyukṣya (l.2) hṛdayenābhimantrya - amṛtīkuryāt । tadanu kṣabhameṇa vastrayugmena uṣṇīṣeṇa samanvitam । karpūrakṣoda saṃyuktaiḥ । (l.3) kuṅkumaikusumaissahā bhasmanā gandhayuktau sarvāṅgānāṃ bhūṣayettataḥ । hemāṅguḻīya kaṭakaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca kuṇḍalaṃ । (l.4) hemayajñopavītaṃ ca pañcāṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇaissaha । parikuryādviśeṣeṇa deśikotyantanirmalaḥ । evaṃ svadehamalaṅkṛtya । (l.5) śivahastakalpanāya svadakṣahastatale vāmāṅguṣṭhe candanālepite āsanamūrttiṃ vinyasya aṅguṣṭādikaniṣṭhānteṣvīśānādi pañcakaṃ vinyasya
(p.18a, f.13b, l.1) vidyādehanetranyāsau vidhāya gaurīmāvāhya aṅgāni kaniṣṭhādīṣukrameṇa vinyasya paramīkṛtya । tejorūpaṃ dhyātvā । (l.2) svaśirasyādhiropayet । brahmarandhrapraviṣṭīnātejasābāhyāntarantamaḥ paṭalamādhūya । pradyoditadigantaraṃ (l.3) saṃbhāvya saptadhāstra japta jñānakhaḍga deśikasvadakṣiṇa kaṭyāṃ sandhārya pañcagavyaṃ naiṛtyāṃ saṃsthāpya (l.4) tato lājacandana siddhārtthaṃ bhasmapuṣpakuśākṣatān saptasaṅkhyān vā śuddhalājānvā vikirān huṃ phaḍantāstreṇa saptadhābhimantryā (l.5) nidhāya tadanu maṇṭape - naiṛtyamīśānābhimukhastitorddhvakāyo pañcagavyārghyābhyāṃ vikīrya astreṇa yāgagṛhaṃ saṃprokṣya nirīkṣaṇādi
(p.18b, f.14a, l.1) catuṣpadāntamaṣṭādaśa saṃskārān śalyanivṛtyartthaṃ nidyaddhyāt nirīkṣaṇa,prokṣaṇa,tāṭana,bhyukṣaṇa,khanana, (l.2) avakīraṇa,pūraṇa,samīkaraṇa,secana,kuṭṭana,sammārjana,(l.3) samālepanāni khaṭgena kuśena vidhāya । nivṛtyādikalābhiḥ ।
(p.19a, f.14b, l.1) paścimottarayāmyapūrvamadhyeṣu nyasu bījamukhyena trisūtraveṣṭana (l.2) mūlenābhyarcanaṃ īśānena prāgāgramudagāgraṃ ca (l.3) rekhatrayaḥ astreṇa ubhayatra triśūlākṛtinā vajrīkaraṇaṃ mūlena pūrvottārāgra kuśadvayena evamaṣṭādaśa saṃskāran kuryāt ।
(p.19b, f.15a, l.1) itthaṃ saṃskṛta yāgagrahe jvalanān astrapūtān nānā praharaṇākārān vikarān huṃphaḍantāstreṇa (l.2) antarikṣa vighnapraśamanārthaṃ vikīrya pradakṣiṇakrameṇāgatvā bhūgata vighnanivāraṇārtthaṃ kuśakūrcena gaurī gāyatryā saṃhṛtyā (l.3) aiśānyāṃ astravarddhanyāsanāyai saṃsthāpya - nairṛtyāṃ vaiṣṇavī pūrvakumbhe । brahmācaturmukhodhyeyo kamaṇḍulvakṣamālikā । (l.4) haṃsārūḍhasamāyukto pītāṅgo vāstu nāyakaḥ ॥ oṃ hrīṃ vāsatvadhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ । vāruṇyāṃ māhendri dakṣiṇavarddhanyāṃ । (l.5) triṇetrāṃ ca caturhastāṃ japāpuṣpasamaprabhām । puṣpabāṇekṣu cāpaṃ ca pāśamambuja dhāriṇīm । citravastradharāṃ caiva mahāmāyāṃ tu bhāvayet ॥ oṃ hrīṃ mahāmāyāyai namaḥ
(p.20a, f.15b, l.1) aiśānyāṃ gurukumbhapaścime pāśupadāstrakumbha varddhanyoḥ sthaṇḍilopari vikarāstrairāsanaṃ saṅkalpya (l.2) tadupari kumbhaṃ tadvāme varddhanīṃ paścimanāḻāṃ saṃsthāpya kumbhe calāsanaṃ saṅkalpya oṃ pāśupadāstrāsanāya namaḥ । (l.3) ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjya - ddhyānaṃ - pañcavaktraṃ mahāghoraṃ daśabāhuṃ trilocanaṃ vikṛtaṃbhāsvaraṃ cograṃ । (l.4) piṅgābhrūśmaśrū mūrddhajaṃ khaḍgakheṭaka nārāca dhanusūtra kamaṇḍaluṃ śakti triśūla paraśuṃ brahmadaṇḍa karānvitam । (l.5) dhyātvā pāśupataṃdevaṃ sāṅgaṃ saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ ॥ pāśupadāstramūrttaye huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । (l.6) oṃ ślīṃ paṃ śuṃ huṃ phaṭ pāśupadāstrāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । ityāvāhānādi pūjāṃ vidhāya -
(p.20b, f.16a, l.1) tatovarddhanyāṃ oṃ pāśupadāstraśaktyāsanāyai namaḥ । ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjyā dhyānaṃ । (l. 2) raktavarṇāṃ jvalatkeśāṃ khaṭgakheṭaka dhāriṇīṃ dhyātvācāstreśvarīṃ devīṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayet । oṃ hrīṃ pāśupadāstramūrttiśaktaye huṃphaṇṇamaḥ । (l. 3) ityāvāhanādikaṃ vidhāyā naivedya dhūpadīpau datvā । tadanu prācyādidikṣu brāhmyādīn prapūjayet । (l.4) pūrvadvārasya gaṇeśa dakṣiṇavarddhanyāṃ - brāhmīṃ pītāṃbarābhūṣāṃ haṃsavāhana saṃsthitām । (l.5) caturbhujādvinetraṃ ca caturvaktrasamanvitām । abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva akṣamālāṃ tu gaṇḍikāṃ ॥ iti dhyātvā (l.6) oṃ hrīṃ brāhmyai namaḥ gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya
(p.21a, f.16b, l.1) bhobhobrāhmītvayāsvasyādiśivighna praśāntaye । sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvat stheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti vijñāpya । (l.2) āgreya varddhanyāṃ - triṇetrāṃ ca caturhastāṃ śuklavarṇena saṃyutāṃ । jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktāṃ ekavaktrasamanvitām । (l.3) abhayaṃ varadopetāṃ mṛgaṭaṅkaṃ ca dhāriṇīṃ । vṛṣavāhanamārūḍhām māheśvarīṃ vibhāvayet ॥ iti dhyātvā (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ māheśvaryai namaḥ gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpau datvā saṃpūjya prārthya - bhobhomāheśvarīsvasyādiśivighnapraśāntaye । (l.5) sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvat stheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti māheśvarī vijñāpya । dakṣiṇadvārasya śāstāpaścimavarddhanyām । (l.6) ekavaktraṃ dvinetraṃ ca nīlavarṇasuyauvanām ।
(p.21b, f.17a, l.1) caturbhujasamāyuktaṃ dvipādena samanvitam । mayuravāhanārūḍhāṃ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitām । (l.2) apareśaktivajraṃ ca abhayaṃ varadaṃ tathā ॥ itiddhyātvā । oṃ hrīṃ kaumāryai namaḥ gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya - (l.3) bhobhomārītvayāsvasyadiśivighnapraśāntaye । sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti kaumāri vijñāpya । (l.4) niṛṛtivarddhanyāṃ - dvinetraṃ ca caturhastaṃ śyāmavarṇa suyauvanāṃ । (l.5) śaṅkhacakradharāṃ devīṃ abhayaṃ varadānvitāṃ । tārkṣyāvāhanamārūḍhāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ॥ itiddhyātvā oṃ hrīṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ (l.6) gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya - bhobhovaiṣṇatvayāsvasyadiśivighnapraśāntaye ।
(p.22a, f.17b, l.1) sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti vaiṣṇaviṃ vijñāpya । paścimadvārasya vīrabhadrottara varddhanyām - (l.2) dvinetrāṃ dvibhujāṃ śāntāṃ kṛṣṇapītāmbarānvitām । varāhavaktrasaṃyuktāṃ raktavarṇa samanvitām । (l.3) kirīṭamakuṭopetāṃ siṃhavāhana madhyakām । halaṃ ca musalāścaiva abhayaṃ varadojvalām ॥ iti dhyātvā (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ vārāhyai namaḥ gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya -(l.5) bhobhovāritvayāsvasyādiśivighnapraśāntaye । sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti vārāhīṃ vijñāpya । (l.6) vāyavyavarddhanyāṃ - dvikṣaṃ caturbhujāṃ śāntāṃ abhayaṃ varadānvitām । vajraśaktiyutopetāṃ hemanīlasvarūpikām ।
(p.22b, f.18a, l.1) saratnamakuṭopetāṃ ārūḍhogajavāhanām ॥ iti dhyātvā - oṃ hrīṃ māhendryai namaḥ(l.2) gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya - bhobhomahitvayāsvasyādiśivighnapraśāntaye । (l.3) sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti māhendriṃ vijñāpya । uttaradvārasya caṇḍeśvarī pūrvavarddhanyāṃ - (l.4) caturbhujāṃ triṇetraṃ ca kāḻameghasavarṇakām । daṃṣṭrākarāḻavadanāṃ vyāghracarmāmbaradharām ।(l.5) keṭakaśūlahastaṃ ca kapālaṃ ca varānvitām । kiṅkiṇīmālayā yuktāṃ karaṇṭamakuṭāṃ śukām ।(l.6) śiromālā samāyuktāṃ pretavāhana saṃsthitām । sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ pīnastana suyauvanām । iti dhyātvā -
(p.23a, f.18b, l.1) oṃ hrīṃ cāmuṇḍyai namaḥ gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya - bhobhomuṇḍītvayāsvasyadiśivighnapraśāntaye । (l.2) sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti cāmuṇḍīṃ vijñāpya । īśāna varddhanyāṃ - (l.3) śaṅkhacakrakirīṭaṃ ca abhayaṃ ūru hastakam । sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ pīnasthanasuyauvanāṃ । caturbhujātriṇetraṃ ca śyāmavarṇasuśobhitāṃ । (l.4) śivadurgāmitiddhyātvā mahiṣoparivāsinam ॥ iti dhyātvā । oṃ hrīṃ śivadurgāyai namaḥ । (l.5) gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya - bhobhodurgātvayāsvasyadiśivighnapraśāntaye । (l.6) sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti durgā vijñāpya । īśānasya dakṣiṇavarddhanyāṃ -
(p.23b, f.19a, l.1) abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva gaṇḍikāṃ vāmahastake । sabye tu padmasaṃyuktāṃ sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutām । sarasvatimitī dhyātvā sāṅgaṃ saṃpūjayet budhaḥ ॥ (l.2) iti dhyātvā oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya prārthya -(l.3) bhobhosaratvayāsvasyadiśivighnapraśāntaye । sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti sarasvatīṃ vijñāpya । (l.4) nirṛṛti uttaravarddhanyām । dvibhujāṃ ca dvinetrāṃ ca saratnamakuṭānvitām । pītavarṇasamāyuktā sarvāvayava sundarīm । (l.5) paṅkajaṃ dakṣiṇehaste śrīphalaṃ vāmahastake । padmamadhyastitāṃ devīṃ hasati dvayadvipārśvake ॥(l.6) iti dhyātvā oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ । gandhapuṣpanaivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjyā prārthya -
(p.24a, f.19b, l.1) bhobholakṣmītvayāsvasyadiśivighnapraśāntaye । sāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ yāvastheyaṃ śivājñayā ॥ iti lakṣmī vijñāpya । evaṃ brāhmyādī - (l.2) daśalokapālān saṃpūjya । anantaraṃ pūrvādīśānta dikṣu khaṭvāṅgādi daśāyudhān prapūjayet । pūrve - dvinetraṃ puruṣākāraṃ khaṭvāṅga śyāmaḻa prabham । (l.3) khaṭgālaṅkṛta mūrddhānaṃ .....krūradṛśaṃ bhavet ॥ oṃhrīṃ khaṭvāṅgāya huṃphaṇṇamaḥ ।(l.4) agnau - triśūlaṃ puruṣodivyo namaśyāma kaḻebaraḥ । ekavaktro dvinetraṃ ca dobhyāṃ kṛta nadīssadā ॥ oṃ hrīṃ triśūlāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । (l.5) dakṣiṇe - ekavaktradvinetraṃ ca ghaṇṭaṃ ca śuklarūpakam । hastaṃ ca dvipādaṃ tu sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ॥ oṃ hrīṃ ghaṇṭāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । (l.6) nairṛṛte - nārācaṃ puruṣākāraṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ suyauvanam । ekavaktraṃ dvinetraṃ ca dvipādaṃ padmasaṃsthitam ॥ oṃ hrīṃ nārācāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ ।
(p.24b, f.20a, l.1) paścime - ḍamaruṃ kṛṣṇavarṇābhaṃ ekavaktraṃ dvinetrakam । mahāghoṣa samāyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhuṣitam ॥ oṃ hrīṃ ḍamarukāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । (l.2) vāyavyām - kapālaṃ puruṣākāraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇa samanvitam । sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram ॥ (l.3)oṃ hrīṃ kapālāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । uttare - ddhvajaṃ vai puruṣākārāmekāsyaṃ ca mahābalā । prapadyesomadigbhāge dvihastaṃ ca dvipādakam ॥ (l.4) oṃ hrīṃ dhvajāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । īśāne - vetāḻaṃ puruṣākāraṃ khaṭgakeṭaka saṃyutam । bhīmadaṃṣṭra samāyuktaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ mahābalam ॥ (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ vetāḻāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । vetāḻasyadakṣiṇe - kṣurīka ugrarūpaṃ ca dvinetraṃ ca dvipādakam । (l.6) nīlavarṇasamāyuktaṃ sarvāśatru kṣayaṃ bhavet ॥ oṃ hrīṃ kṣurikāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । nārācsyottare - nāsāyopannagākāraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ puruṣākṛtam ।
(p.25a, f.20b, l.1) pāśasaptapaṇopetaṃ nairṛṛtastyaṃ tu uttare ॥ oṃ hrīṃ pāśāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । sarve gandhapuṣpa naivedya dhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । (l.2) tadanu guruḥ pāśupadāstra varddhanīṃ pūrvamādāya paścāt । pāśupadāstrakumbha śiṣyeṇāvāhayitvā - (l.3) kumbhagragāmi varddhanīnāḻot gata avicchinna jalādhārāṃ pade pade prapātayan oṃ ślīṃ paṃ śuṃ huṃ phaṭ pāśupadāstrāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ iti mūlamantraṃ phaṭhan । (l.4) astra durgamanusmaran । īśānā...śāntaṃ । yajñasaṃrakṣaṇārtthāya vighnānāṃ dhvaṃsa hetave । (l.5) rakṣaṇīya mukhaṃ caiva lokapālāsamāhitāḥ ॥ ityuktvā paribhrāmya āsane svasthāne pūrva kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya paścāt varddhanīṃ saṃsthāpya । (l.6) kumbhavarddhanyoḥ sthirāsanaṃ saṅkalpya । tadyathā - oṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ । oṃ antāsanāya namaḥ । oṃ dharmakandāya namaḥ । oṃ jñānanāḻāya namaḥ ।
(p.25b, f.21a, l.1) oṃ vairāgyakesarāya namaḥ । oṃ aiśvaryakarṇikāya namaḥ । oṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ । oṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ । oṃ pāśupadāstrāsanāya namaḥ । ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjya । dhyānaṃ pañcavaktraṃ mahāghoraṃ daśabāhuṃ trilocanam । vikṛtaṃ bhāskaraṃ cograṃ piṅgabhrūśmaśru mūrddhajam । (l.2) khaṭgakeṭakanārācaṃ dhanusūtrakamaṇḍalum । śaktitriśū paraśuṃ prabhudaṇḍakarānvitam । (l.3) dhyātvāpāśupadaṃ devaṃ sāṅgaṃ saṃpūjayet budhaḥ ॥(l.4) itidhyātvā - kumbhe oṃ hāṃ pāśupadāstramūrttaye huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । iti mūrttiṃ vinyasya । (l.5) oṃ ślīṃ paṃ śuṃ huṃ phaṭ pāśupadāstrāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ - ityāvāhanādikaṃ vidhāyā - oṃ hāṃ hṛdayāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । (l.6) oṃ hīṃ śirase huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । oṃ hūṃ śikhāyai huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । oṃ haiṃ kavacāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ ।
(p.26a, f.21b, l.1) oṃ hauṃ netrebhyo huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । oṃ haḥ astrāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । ityaṅgānivinyasya mūlenarakṣāvakuṇṭhana amṛtīkaraṇāni vidhāya (l.2) gandhapuṣpa naivedya dhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । tatovāmabhāga varddhanyāṃ sthaṇḍilopari vinyasya ādhāraśaktiṃ saṃpūjya (l.3) dhyānaṃ - raktavarṇāṃ jvalatkeśāṃ khaṭgakheṭaka dhāriṇīṃ dhyātvācāstreśvarīṃ devīṃ gandhapuṣpādi arcayet । (l.4) itidhyātvā varddhanyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ pāśupadāstramūrttiśaktaye huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । (l.5) oṃ hrīṃ śirase huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । oṃ hrūṃ śikhāyai huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । oṃ hraiṃ kavacāyai huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । (l.6) oṃ hrauṃ netrebhyo huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । oṃ hraḥ astrāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ । ityaṅgāni vinyasya
(p.26b, f.22a, l.1) śaktimūlena rakṣāvakuṇṭhana amṛtīkaraṇāni vidhāya - gandhapuṣpa naivedya dhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । (l.2) oṃ hauṃ srauṃ śivaśaktibhyānnamaḥ iti liṅgamudrayā mūlena aṅguṣṭhena kumbhaṃ saṃsparśya muṣṭinā varddhanīṃ saṃsparsya (l.3) umāyai bhagarūṇyailiṅgarūpa dharāya ca śaṅkarāya namastubhyaṃ itistuktvā namodya ca । yajñasyāsya - (l.4) patistvaṃ hi mūrttireṣā tavā calā eṣate jñāninastriṃśat tatgṛhāṇa svamāyudhaḥ । (l.5) niśchayāgannāthā rakṣābhaktānu kampayā - itisaṃśrāvya rakṣārtthaṃ kumbhe jñānakhaṭgaṃ niveśya - iti devasya savyahaste huṃ phaḍantāstreṇa (l.6) jñānakhaḍgaṃ samarpya mūlamantraṃyathāśaktyājaptvā kumbhesamarpya taddaśāṃśaṃ śaktimūlaṃ japtvā
(p.27a, f.22b, l.1) varddhanyāṃ niveśya - mayāpravarttitaścāyāṃ yajvanā bhavataḥ kṛtuḥ rakṣaṇīyasva yaistvaṃ hi samāptiryāvadasvahi - (l.2) iti vijñāpya nirodhārghyaṃ datvā । tatpātraṃ tatraiva niśchalaṃ sthāpayet । vāyavyāṃ māhendrī pūrvavarddhanyāṃ (l.3) caturbhujāṃ dvinetrāṃ ca nīlotpaladaḻaprabhām । pāśāṅkudharāṃ devīṃ pūrṇakumbhotpalānvitām ॥ (l.4) pītāmbaradharāṃ caiva bhāvayet lokamohanīm । oṃ klīṃ mohinyai namaḥ । gandhapuṣpa (l.5) naivedya dhūpadīpādibhissaṃpūjya । aiśānyāṃ durgāpaścimakumbhe saptagurumabhyarccya - oṃ sadāśivagurave namaḥ । (l.6) oṃ anantagurave namaḥ । oṃ śrīkaṇṭhagurave namaḥ । oṃ ambikāgurave namaḥ । oṃ guhagurave namaḥ । oṃ viṣṇugurave namaḥ । oṃ dhātṛgurave namaḥ ।
(p.27b, f.23a, l.1) evaṃ saptagurumabhyarccya - ddhyāyet - jaṭāmakuṭa śobhāḍhyaṃ bhasmapāṇḍara vigrahaṃ । yogapaṭṭayutaṃ brahma sūtranābhisthalopari । (l.2) kṛtayogākhya mudrāṃ ca iti śāntaṃ guruṃ param ॥ oṃ hāṃ gurubhyo namaḥ । (l.3) deva deva jagannāthā jagadānandakāraṇa । śivāddhvara prapattoyaṃ tavajñāṃ kurute namaḥ ॥ iti guruṃ vijñāpya - paścāt vedikā dakṣiṇesthivā - (l.4) vedikopari pādyādi arghyasaṃyuktaṃ pātrāṇi pūjayet । tataḥ atha vā pātramekaṃ tu pādyamācanārghyakam । (l.5) pātrāṇyastreṇaprakṣāḻya sthalikopari vinyaset । dakṣiṇe pādyasaṃyuktaṃ uttare ācamanīyakaṃ arghyamadhye tu vinyasya । (l.6) trividhamarcayet kramāt । pādyasyādhāre oṃ bhūmyai namaḥ । pātramūle oṃ māyāyai namaḥ । valaye oṃ sūryamūrttaye namaḥ ।
(p.28a, f.23b, l.1) mūdhye oṃ haḥ amṛtaśaktyai namaḥ ityadhidevatānabhyarccya । punarācamanapātrasyādhāre oṃ dharitryai namaḥ । (l.2) pātramūle oṃ yoginyai namaḥ । valaye oṃ somamūrttaye namaḥ । mūdhye oṃ amṛtaśaktyai namaḥ ityācamanapātrādhidevatānabhyarccya । (l.3) tayormadhye tripāde oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ oṃ rudrāya namaḥ vṛtte oṃ ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ tadupari śaṅkhamūle oṃ dhārādevyai namaḥ । (l.4) kukṣau oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ । dhāre oṃ aghorāya namaḥ । valaye sūryāya namaḥ । mukhe saptatīrthāya namaḥ । (l.5) praveśe oṃ candrāya namaḥ teṣu dakṣiṇa hastena amṛtabindu jalenāpūrya pādyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamantreṇa ।
(p.28b, f.24a, l.1) ācamanīyaṃ pañcabrahmeṇa pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgābhyāṃ arghyañcābhimantrya śivagāyatrī yāteṣvabhimantrya rakṣāvakuṇṭhana dhenumudrayā amṛtīkṛtya dhūpadīpau datvā (l.2) tadanu devasya dakṣiṇabhāge nirodhārghyaṃ svāgatārghyaṃ parāṅmukhārghyāni tattadravyeṇa (l.3) saha pūrvoktaviśeṣārghyaṃ । mantroktaprakāreṇa saṅkalpya - kāmike devīsthāpana kāletu śaktiṃ ādhāra rūpiṇīm । (l.4) tato antāsanaṃ kalpya siṃhāsanaṃ tatopari ūrdhvādhaśchadane yogepadme vāmādibhivinā । (l.5) maṇḍalatrayaṃ saṅkalpya । kriyaicchājñānaśaktibhiḥ tadūrdhvacchādiśaktiśca tatodevyāsanaṃ yajet । tadyathāvedikopari sthaṇḍile ।
(p.29a, f.24b, l.1) adhaḥ kūrmaśilāsīnāṃ kṣīrodasitavigrahām । maulau bījāṃkurākārāṃ varadāmabhayapradām । (l.2) pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ śaktiṃ kriyāmādhārarūpiṇīm ॥ oṃ hāṃ ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ tadupari pṛthvīkandaṃ kalāntaikanālakaṃ bhāvakaṇṭakam । (l.3) kṣubdhamāyāmahāpadmamanekadalasaṃkulam । anantāsanamidaṃ haritāla samaprabham । tanmadhyegamanaṃ deśaṃ prabhuṃ vyāpyāsthitaṃ tvadhaḥ ॥ (l.4) śvetaṃ caturmukhaṃ cāṣṭa bhujadvādaśalocanam । ddhyāyet brahmaśilāmadhye yajeddevaṃ śivāsane । (l.5) karṇikāmadhye oṃ hāṃ ananteśāya namaḥ prāgādi digdaḻeṣu oṃ hāṃ anantāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ vāsukaye namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ takṣakāya namaḥ ।
(p.29b, f.25a, l.1) oṃ hāṃ kārkoṭakāya namaḥ । āgneyādi digdaḻeṣu oṃ hāṃ padmāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ mahāpadmāya namaḥ । (l.2) oṃ hāṃ śaṅkhāyai namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ guḻikāya namaḥ । oṃ anantāsanāya namaḥ । anantamāsanaṃ proktaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tatopari । (l.3) vicitrakesariprakhyān anyonyaṃ pṛṣṭhadarśinam । koṭī koṭīka siṃhaiśca pratyekaṃ parivārakān ॥ (l.4) sitakāśmīraktāḻī cārusiṃhākṛtīn smaran । dharmajñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca tathaiva ca । āgneyādīśaparyantakoṇeṣu ca yathākramam ॥ (l.5) āgneyādi koṇeṣu oṃ hāṃ dharmāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ jñānāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ vairāgyāya namaḥ, oṃ hāṃ aiśvaryāya namaḥ
(p.30a, f.25b, l.1) gātrakān sphaṭikaprakhyān tryakṣān siṃhaśirodhṛtān । stabdhabāhuśirogrīvān pādukāsaktamastakān । agragātrakapādasthamastakānnararūpiṇaḥ ॥ (l.2) dhyāyan buddhiguṇādharmamukhādhiṣṭhāyakānyajet । pūrvādidikṣu - oṃ hāṃ adharmāya namaḥ, oṃ hāṃ ajñānāya namaḥ, (l.3) oṃ hāṃ avairāgyāya namaḥ, oṃ hāṃ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ guṇatrayeṇa saṃścādyamevaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ bhavet । (l.4) oṃ hāṃ sātvika rājastāmasa saṃścadanāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ siṃhāsanāya namaḥ (l.5) evaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ proktaṃ । yogāsanaṃ tatopari । kṛtākhyaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu tretāpādaṃ tu raktakam ।
(p.30b, f.26a, l.1) dvāparaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tu kaliṃsyātpītavarṇakam । (l.2) āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu bhūtarūpaṃ vibhāvayet ॥ oṃ hāṃ kṛtayugāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ tretāyugāya namaḥ । (l.3) oṃ hāṃ dvāparayugāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ kaliyugāya namaḥ । avyaktasphaṭikābhāsāniyatiḥ kālāñjanadvitiḥ । (l.4) kāloḍāḍima puṣpābhākalābhinnāñjanaprabhā । (l.5) prāgādiṣkaḻikāproktā madhyapādaṃ tu keśavaḥ । pūrvādidikṣu - oṃ hāṃ avyaktāya namaḥ । (l.6) oṃ hāṃ niyataye namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ kālāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ kalāyai namaḥ ।
(p.31a, f.26b, l.1) madhyapāde keśavāya namaḥ । adhaścadanamūrddhvaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ vicintayet ।(l.2) nairṛṛtyāmīśadikbhāge māyāvidyātmakaṃ param । nairṛṛte oṃ hāṃ adhaścadanāya namaḥ । (l.3) īśāne oṃ hāṃ ūrdhvaścadanāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ yogāsanāya namaḥ । (l.4) evaṃ yogāsanaṃ proktaṃ padmāsanaṃ tatopari । (l.5) māyātattvaṃ bṛhatkandaṃ śuddhavidyābja śobhitam । vidyeśvaradaḻaścinnaṃ śaktikesara saṃyutam । vidyātattvamayaṃ tatra karṇikāṃ saṃprakalpayet । (l.6)
(p.31b, f.27a, l.1) māṇikkasadṛśaṃ kandaṃ aṅkuraṃ rajita prabham । tasyanāḻaṃ tu vaiḍūryaṃ mukuḻaṃ śyāmavarṇakam । (l.2) kaṇṭakaṃ tu pravāḻābhaṃ karṇikāraktapiṅgaḻam śaṅkhavarṇadaḻāgraṃ ca raktaṃ copadaḻaṃ smṛtam । (l.3) keśaraṃ hemavarṇābham agre muktākṛtīyutam । oṃ hāṃ kandāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ bījāya namaḥ । (l.4) oṃ hāṃ aṅkurāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ nāḻāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ mukuḻāya namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ kaṇṭakebhyo namaḥ । (l.5) oṃ hāṃ daḻebhyo namaḥ । oṃ hāṃ upadaḻebhyo namaḥ । (l.6) iti vidyeśvarāṣṭaka rūpāṇi daḻāni sañcintyābhyarccya । oṃ hāṃ keśarebhyo namaḥ ।
(p.32a, f.27b, l.1) taptacāmīkaracchāyāṃ pañcāśadbījagarbhitām । kesarāṇāñcatuṣṣaṣṭyā karṇikāṃ pūjayettataḥ ॥ (l.2) oṃ hāṃ karṇikāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ bījebhyo namaḥ samuditarūpaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca yajet । (l.3) oṃ hāṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ । evaṃ padmāsanaṃ proktaṃ tasyordhve vimalāsanam । (l.4) maṇḍatrayamatraiva kalpayedvimalāsanaṃ daḻāgravṛttake caiva kalādvādaśa saṃyutam । (l.5) koṭyādīta pratīkāśaṃ śivasūryasya maṇḍalaṃ oṃ hāṃ sūryamaṇḍalāya namaḥ (l.6) sūryamaṇḍalādhipataye oṃ hrīṃ jñānaśaktyai namaḥ
(p.32b, f.28a, l.1) karṇikāmadhyame caiva gokṣīra dhavaḻa prabham । jñānānanda mayaṃ caiva śaktimaṇḍalakaṃ yajet ॥ (l.2) oṃ hāṃ śaktimaṇḍalāya namaḥ śaktimaṇḍalādhipatyai oṃ hrīṃ ādiśaktyai namaḥ । (l.3) kṣityādikuṭilāprāntaṃ mantrasiṃhāsanaprabham । (l.4) sūryakoṭisamaprakhyaṃ devyāsanaṃ tu bhāvayet । oṃ hrāṃ manonmanyāsanāyai namaḥ ।
(p.33a, f.28b, l.1) tadupari puṣpāñjaliṃ hṛtpradeśe nidhāya oṃ hrīṃ manonmanimūrttaye namaḥ । (l.2) iti viṅpantamuccāryā । mūrttiṃ saṃpūrṇaparaṃ jyoti rūpāṃdaṇḍākārāmavibhaktāvayavāṃ (l.3) śivatattvātmaka para binduvyāptikāṃ (l.4) vibhāvyā jñāna kriyāścā svarūpam
(p.33b, f.29a, l.1) maṇḍalatraya madhye niveśayet । asyāṃ mūrtau daṇḍabhaṅgyā mūrddhnādi pādaparyantaṃ īśānādi vinyasya । (l.2) oṃ hroṃ īśānamūrddhāmbikāyai namaḥ । oṃ hreṃ tatpuruṣavaktra gaṇāmbikāyai namaḥ । oṃ hruṃ aghora hṛdaya gaṅgāyai namaḥ । (l.3) oṃ hriṃ vāmadevaguhyāya gauryai namaḥ । oṃ hraṃ sadyojāta umāyai namaḥ । iti vinyasya । (l.4) anantaraṃ kalābhaṅgyā gaurīkalānyaset tadyathā - mūrddhnī oṃ hrīṃ tārāyai namaḥ । vaktre oṃ hrīṃ vidyāyai namaḥ । hṛdaye oṃ hrīṃ muninyai namaḥ । (l.5) karṇe oṃ hrīṃ śuddhāyai namaḥ । dakṣiṇāṃse oṃ hrīṃ rajāyai namaḥ । vāmāṃse oṃ hrīṃ medhāyai namaḥ ।
(p.34a, f.29b, l.1) jaṭhare oṃ hrīṃ svadhāyai namaḥ । nābhau oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ । yonau oṃ hrīṃ pālinyai namaḥ । guhye oṃ hrīṃ jvālinyai namaḥ । (l.2) dakṣiṇorū oṃ hrīṃ tṛṣṇāyai namaḥ । vāmorū oṃ hrīṃ dhṛtyai namaḥ । dakṣiṇa jānunī oṃ hrīṃ kalāyai namaḥ । vāmajānunī oṃ hrīṃ prajāyai namaḥ । (l.3) dakṣiṇajaṅghāyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ cintāyai namaḥ । vāmajaṅghāyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ bhūtyai namaḥ । pṛṣṭhe oṃ hrīṃ kriyāyai namaḥ । (l.4) dakṣiṇapārśve oṃ hrīṃ kṣāntyai namaḥ । vāmapārśve oṃ hrīṃ śāntyai namaḥ । dakṣiṇapāṇau oṃ hrīṃ smṛtyai namaḥ । (l.5) vāmapāṇau oṃ hrīṃ dityai namaḥ । dakṣiṇastane oṃ hrīṃ dvityai namaḥ । vāmastane oṃ hrīṃ sāddhyai namaḥ । iti gaurīkalānyāsaṃ vidhāyā-
(p.34b, f.30a, l.1) śaktenāne sakaḻāvijñeyā niṣkaḻaśśivaḥ । kṣityādikuṭilā prāntā mantrasiṃhāsanasthitām । indranīlamaṇiprakhyāṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaṇānvitām । (l.2) padmāsanasthitāṃ caiva triṇetrāṃ yauvanojvalām । dṛkriyeścaviśālākṣāṃ jñānacandrakalānvitām । (l.3) nāgopavītasaṃyuktāṃ citravastradharānvitām । gandhamālāsamāyuktāṃ vāñcitārtha pradāyinīm । itthaṃ manonmanīṃ dhyātvā sarvakarmasamācaret ॥ (l.4) yadvā - yathoktavat dhyātvā - puṣpāñjalissan oṃ sauṃ vidyādehāyai namaḥ śaktyantavyāpakaṃ prāsādamuccārya ।
(p.35a, f.30b, l.1) saudāminanibhāṃ sṛga jalāvāvirbhūtāṃ dhyātvā - bimbe vidyādehaṃ samuditarūpaṃ vinyasya - oṃ srauṃ netrebhyo namaḥ iti netraṃ vinyasya । (l.2) anantaramrajūrdhvakāyassan pūṣpairañjalimāpūrya hṛtpradeśenidhāya । oṃ hyauṃ manonmanyai namaḥ । iti mūlamantraṃ (l.3) brahmādikāraṇatyākrameṇa dvādaśāntamuccāryā । sarvātmikāṃ niṣkaḻāṃ vibhuṃ jñānānandamayīṃ svaprakāśāṃ sañcintya (l.4) sṛṣṭikrameṇa dvādaśāntāt pataṅgapiṅgābhāṃ lalāṭevatārya candrakoṭi sadṛśāṃ tiryak sudhā pāṇḍaratāṃ maṇḍalāndhyātvā (l.5) prāṇapravāhavartmanā vinirgatyāñjaligatāṃ vicintya lakṣāmūrtau hṛdayakamale āvahini mudrayāvāhya sthāpanādikaṃ kṛtvā । (l.6) svāgadārghyaṃ datvā । svāgadante mahādevīti vijñāpya । vatsasvāgatamiti gauryoktaṃ vibhāvya ।
(p.35b, f.31a, l.1) gaurī sarva jagannāthe yāvat pūjāvasānakaṃ । tāvatvaṃ prītibhāvena kumbhesmin sannidhī bhava ॥ iti vijñāpya hṛdayādikarāntasthāneṣu । oṃ srāṃ hṛdayavāminyai namaḥ । oṃ srīṃ śiranīlinyai namaḥ । (l.2) oṃ srūṃ śikhācakriṇyai namaḥ । oṃ sraiṃ kavacapāśāṅgyai namaḥ । oṃ srauṃ netrakhaṭganyai namaḥ । (l.3) oṃ sraḥ astragāmbhinyai namaḥ । iti vinyasya mūlenaikatvaṃ vidhāya astreṇasaṃrakṣya kavacenāvakuṇṭhya । (l.4) mūlena dhenumudrāṃ mahāmudrāṃ padmamudrāṃ śūlamudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ ca pradarśya - śakti mūlena pādyācamanārghyāṇi datvā । (l.5) vauṣaḍanta mūlena saṃpūjya - tatovāmabhāgapīṭha varddhanyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ puṣpākṣatāni dadyāt - naivedya dhūpadīpau datvā manorathamudrāṃ darśayitvā । (l.6) śaktimūlena saṃpūjya tato vāmabhāgapīṭhavarddhanyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhaśaktyāsanāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhaśaktimūrttaye namaḥ । ddhyāyet
(p.36a, f.31b, l.1) dvinetraṃ dvibhujāṃ pītāṃ śuklavastra dharānvitām । karaṇḍamakuṭopetāṃ sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitām ॥ (l.2) pīṭhaśaktiṃ sukhāsīnāṃ bhāvayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ । oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhaśaktyai namaḥ naivedya dhūpādīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya । tadanu vāmādīn prapūjayet । (l.3) pūrve - oṃ hrīṃ vāmāsanāyai namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ vāmamūrttaye namaḥ । vāmāṃ nīlaprabhāṃ devīṃ makuṭāṃ divi bhūṣitām । ॥ (l.4) śaṅkhacakradharāṃ caivā bhāvayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥ oṃ hrīṃ vāmāyai namaḥ agnau - oṃ hrīṃ jyeṣṭhāsanāyai namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ jyeṣṭhamūrttaye namaḥ । (l.5) pītavarṇaprabhāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ padmadhṛt padmalocanām । sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ susthānāṃ ca suyauvvanām ॥ oṃ hrīṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ ।

(p.46a, f.41b, l.1) oṃ aḥ anantāyai namaḥ āsye । oṃ kaṃ sṛṣṭyainamaḥ dakṣiṇabāhumūle । oṃ khaṃ ṛddhyai namaḥ kūrpare । (l.2) oṃ gaṃ sthityai namaḥ maṇibandhe । oṃ ghaṃ medhāyai namaḥ pāṇitale । oṃ ṅaṃ prājñāyai namaḥ karāgre । (l.3) oṃ caṃ lakṣmyai namaḥ vāmabāhumūle । oṃ chaṃ matyai namaḥ kūrpare । oṃ jaṃ virāyai namaḥ maṇibandhe । (l.4) oṃ jhaṃ svastyai namaḥ pāṇitale । oṃ ñaṃ smṛtyai namaḥkarāgre । (l.5) oṃ ṭaṃ jarāyai namaḥ dakṣiṇorūmūle । oṃ ṭhaṃ pālyai namaḥ jānuni । oṃ ḍaṃ pārvatyai namaḥ jaṅghāyām । (l.6) oṃ ḍhaṃ aiśvaryai namaḥpādatale । oṃ ṇaṃ ratyai namaḥ pādāgre । oṃ taṃ mūḻāyai namaḥ vāmorūmūle ।
(p.46b, f.42a, l.1) oṃ thaṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ jānuni । oṃ daṃ hṛtyai namaḥ jaṅghāyām । oṃ dhaṃ dīrghāyai namaḥ pādataḻe । (l.2) oṃ naṃ tīkṣṇāyai namaḥ pādāgre । oṃ paṃ raudrāyai namaḥ dakṣiṇapārśve । (l.3) oṃ phaṃ bhayāyai namaḥ vāmapārśve । oṃ baṃ śrutyai namaḥ pṛṣṭhe । oṃ bhaṃ bhadrāyai namaḥ nābhideśe । oṃ maṃ dhātryai namaḥ jaṭhare । (l.4) oṃ yaṃ sudhāyai namaḥ tvaci । oṃ raṃ krāntyai namaḥ rakte । oṃ laṃ krīyāyai namaḥ māṃse । (l.5) oṃ vaṃ utkāyai namaḥ medasi । oṃ śaṃ mṛtyai namaḥ asthani । oṃ ṣaṃ pikā..yai namaḥ majjasthane । (l.6) oṃ saṃ śvetāyai namaḥ retasi । oṃ haṃ aruṇāyai namaḥ hṛdaye । oṃ ḻaṃ vidyāyai namaḥ gaḻe । oṃ kṣaṃ acitāyai namaḥ stane । iti devi śrīkaṇṭhanyāsaḥ - (p.47a, f.42b) devīṣaḍadhvanyāsaḥ (l.1) mūrddhni oṃ hauṃ śāntyatītakalāyai namaḥ । vaktre oṃ haiṃ śāntikalāyai namaḥ । (l.2) hṛdaye oṃ hrūṃ vidyākalāyai namaḥ । nābhau oṃ hvīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāyai namaḥ । (l.3) pādayoḥ oṃ hlāṃ nivṛttikalāyai namaḥ । iti kalādhvā - tadanu brahmarandhre oṃ hāṃ śivatattvāya namaḥ śivatattvādhipāyai namaḥ oṃ śivāya namaḥ brahmarandhrasthāne । (l.4) oṃ śaktitattvāya namaḥ śaktitattvādhipataye namaḥ oṃ śaktimataye namaḥ mūrddhniyorghaṇḍikordhve । (l.5) oṃ sadāśivatattvāya namaḥ sadāśivatattvādhipāyai namaḥ oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ ghaṇḍikādhaskandhaparyantam । (l.6) oṃ īśvaratattvāya namaḥ īśvaratattvādhipataye namaḥ oṃ anantāya namaḥ dakṣiṇapārśve । oṃ śuddhavidyātattvāya namaḥ śuddhavidyātattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ śambarāya namaḥ vāmapārśve ।
(p.47b, f.43a, l.1) oṃ māyātattvāya namaḥ māyātattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ gaganeśānamaḥ hṛdaye । (l.2) oṃ kalātattvāya namaḥ kalātattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ jñānabindave namaḥ urasi । oṃ vidyātattvāya namaḥ vidyātattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ vedavijñānāya namaḥ udare । (l.3) oṃ kālatattvāya namaḥ kālatattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ kālanāmne namaḥ । oṃ niyatitattvāya namaḥ niyatitattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ niyāmakāyanamaḥ । (l.4) oṃ rāgatattvāya namaḥ rāgatattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ kāmadāya namaḥ । (l.5) oṃ puruṣatattvāya namaḥ puruṣatattvādhipataye namaḥ । oṃ sūkṣmadehāya namaḥ । iticatuṣkamudare pṛṣṭhepārśve
(p.48a, f.43b, l.1) oṃ prakṛtitattvāya namaḥ prakṛtitattvādhipataye pradhānakāya namaḥ nābhimeḍrāntare । oṃ guṇatattvāya namaḥ guṇatattvādhipataye tridehāya namaḥ diksandhiṣu । (l.2) oṃ buddhitattvāya namaḥ buddhitattvādhipataye buddhāyanamaḥ dakṣiṇorau । (l.3) oṃ ahaṅkāratattvāya namaḥ ahaṅkātatattvādhipataye ahaṅkṛtine namaḥ vamorau । oṃ manastattvāya namaḥ manastattvādhipataye saṅkalpāya namaḥ śrotrayoḥ । (l.4) oṃ śrotratattvāya namaḥ śrotratattvādhipataye vyomacarāya namaḥ tvaci । (l.5) oṃ tvaktattvāya namaḥ tvaktattvādhipataye sarvāṅgāya namaḥ cakṣuṣi । oṃ cakṣustattvāya namaḥ cakṣustattvādhipataye prakāśāya namaḥ jihvāyām ।
(p.48b, f.44a, l.1) oṃ jihvātattvāya namaḥ jihvātattvādhipataye mahāvaktrāya namaḥ nāsikāyām । oṃ nāsātattvāya namaḥ nāsātattvādhipataye vilumbukāya namaḥ āsye । (l.2) oṃ vāktattvāya namaḥ vāktattvādhipataye dundubhaye namaḥ pādāyoḥ । (l.3) oṃ pādatattvāya namaḥ pādatattvādhipataye ramaṇāya namaḥ । pāṇyoḥ ।(l.4) oṃ pāṇitattvāya namaḥ pāṇitattvādhipataye tūrṇakṛte namaḥ । pāyau । oṃ pāyutattvāya namaḥ pāyutattvādhipataye ramaṇāya namaḥ । upasthe ।(l.5) oṃ upasthatattvāya namaḥ upasthatattvādhipataye ghanānandāya namaḥ । nābhau । (l.6) oṃ śabdatattvāya namaḥ śabdatattvādhipataye sūkṣmanādāya namaḥ । lalāṭe । oṃ sparśatattvāya namaḥ sparśatattvādhipataye balavattarāya namaḥ । vaktre ।
(p.49a, f.44b, l.1) oṃ rūpatattvāya namaḥ rūpatattvādhipataye bhānumate namaḥ । hṛdaye । oṃ rasatattvāya namaḥ rasatattvādhipataye jaladāya namaḥ । nābhau । (l.2) oṃ gandhatattvāya namaḥ gandhatattvādhipataye gandhāya namaḥ । yonyām । oṃ vyomatattvāya namaḥ vyomatattvādhipataye sūkṣmāya namaḥ । guhye । (l.3) oṃ vāyutattvāya namaḥ vāyutattvādhipataye mātariśvane namaḥ । yonyājyantare । vītasthāne । (l.4) oṃ agnitattvāya namaḥ agnitattvādhipataye tviṣānnidhaye namaḥ । yonyayojānu maṇḍalāpadhi । (l.5) oṃ jalatattvāya namaḥ jalatattvādhipataye jaleśāya namaḥ । jānvadhaḥ । (l.6) oṃ pṛthivitattvāya namaḥ pṛthivītattvādhipataye śrīkaṇṭhāya namaḥ । evaṃ krameṇa vinyaset iti tattvanyāsaḥ hariḥ oṃ śivamayam
(p.49b, f.45a, l.1) śirasī oṃ annamaḥ । mukhamaṇḍale oṃ ānnamaḥ । dakṣiṇa cakṣuṣu oṃ innamaḥ । vāmacakṣuṣi oṃ īnnamaḥ । dakṣiṇakarṇe oṃ unnamaḥ । (l.2) vāmakarṇe oṃ ūnnamaḥ । dakṣiṇa nāsāpuṭe oṃ ṛnnamaḥ । vāmanāsāpuṭe oṃ ṝnnamaḥ । dakṣiṇagaṇḍe oṃ ḷnnamaḥ । (l.3) vāmagaṇḍe oṃ ḹnnamaḥ । ūrdhveṣṭhe oṃ ennamaḥ । adharoṣṭhe oṃ ainnamaḥ । ūrdhvadante oṃ onnamaḥ । adhodante oṃ aunnamaḥ । (l.4) jihvāyām oṃ aṃ namaḥ । āsye oṃ aḥ namaḥ । dakṣiṇahastabhuje oṃ kaṃ namaḥ । kūrpare oṃ khaṃ namaḥ । (l.5) maṇibandhe oṃ gaṃ namaḥ । hastadaḻe oṃ ghaṃ namaḥ । aṅgulyagre oṃ ṅaṃ namaḥ । vāmahastabhuje oṃ caṃ namaḥ । kūrpare oṃ chaṃ namaḥ । maṇibandhe oṃ jaṃ namaḥ । hastadaḻe oṃ jhaṃ namaḥ । aṅgulyagre oṃ ñaṃ namaḥ । (l.6) oṃ dakṣiṇorumūle ṭaṃ namaḥ । jānuni oṃ ṭhaṃ namaḥ । jaṅghe oṃ ḍaṃ namaḥ । pādadaḻe oṃ ḍhaṃ namaḥ । pādāṅguḻyagre oṃ ṇaṃ namaḥ ।
(p.50a, f.45b, l.1) vāmorumūle oṃ taṃ namaḥ । jānuni oṃ thaṃ namaḥ । jaṅghe oṃ daṃ namaḥ । pādadaḻe oṃ dhaṃ namaḥ । (l.2) pādāṅgulyagre oṃ naṃ namaḥ । dakṣiṇapārśve oṃ paṃ namaḥ । vāmapārśve oṃ phaṃ namaḥ । pṛṣṭhe oṃ baṃ namaḥ । nābhau oṃ bhaṃ namaḥ । (l.3) jaṭhare oṃ maṃ namaḥ । hṛdaye oṃ yaṃ namaḥ । dakṣiṇāṃse oṃ raṃ namaḥ । vāmāṃse oṃ laṃ namaḥ । skandhe oṃ vaṃ namaḥ । (l.4) dakṣiṇakakṣe oṃ śaṃ namaḥ । vāmakakṣe oṃ ṣaṃ namaḥ । dakṣiṇapāṇipādānte oṃ saṃ namaḥ । (l.5) vāmapāṇipādānte oṃ haṃ namaḥ । hṛdayādi mūrddhānte oṃ ḻaṃ namaḥ । hṛdayādi pādānte oṃ kṣaṃ namaḥ । (l.6) krameṇa ekapañcāśat varṇadhvanyāset ॥ padādhvanyāsaḥ ।
(p.50b, f.46a, l.1) mūrddhni oṃ onnamaḥ । vaktre oṃ vyomavyāpine namaḥ । hṛdaye oṃ vyomarūpāya namaḥ guhye oṃ sarvavyāpine namaḥ । (l.2) pāde oṃ śivāya namaḥ । lalāṭe oṃ anantāya namaḥ । cubuke oṃ anāthāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇanetre oṃ anāśritāya namaḥ । (l.3) vāmanetre oṃ dhruvāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇaśrotre oṃ śāśvatāya namaḥ । vāmaśrotre oṃ yogapīṭha saṃsthitāya namaḥ (l.4) dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭe oṃ nitya-yogine namaḥ । (l.5) vāmanāsāpuṭe oṃ dhyānāharāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇakapole oṃ namaḥ śivāya namaḥ ।
(p.51a, f.46b, l.1) vāmakapole oṃ sarvaprabhave namaḥ । āsyāṃ oṃ śivāya namaḥ । mūrddhnī oṃ īśānamūrdhāya namaḥ । vaktre oṃ tatpuruṣavaktrāya namaḥ । (l.2) hṛdaye oṃ aghorahṛdayāya namaḥ guhye oṃ vāmadevaguhyāyanamaḥ pādau oṃ sadyojātamūrtaye namaḥ । (l.3) dakṣiṇabāhumūle oṃ namo namaḥ । kūrpare oṃ guhyādiguhyāya namaḥ । maṇibandhe oṃ goptre namaḥ । (l.4) hastadaḻe oṃ anidhanāya namaḥ । hastadaḻapṛṣṭhe sarvayogakṛtāye namaḥ । aṅguṣṭhe sarvavidyādhipātaye namaḥ । (l.5) tarjanyāṃ oṃ jyotīrūpāya namaḥ madhyamāṅguḻyām oṃ parameśvaraparāya namaḥ
(p.51b, f.47a, l.1) anāmikāyām oṃ acetanācetanāya namaḥ । kaniṣṭhikāyām vyomin vyomin namaḥ । vāmabāhumūle oṃ vyāpin vyāpin namaḥ । (l.2) kūrpare oṃ arūpin arūpin namaḥ । maṇibandhe oṃ prathamaprathamāya namaḥ । hastadaḻe oṃ tejastejāya namaḥ । (l.3) hastadaḻapṛṣṭhe oṃ jyotirjyotiṣe namaḥ । aṅguṣṭhe oṃ arūpāya namaḥ । tarjannyāṃ oṃ anagnaye namaḥ (l.4) madhyamāṅguḻyāṃ oṃ adhūmāya namaḥ anāmikāyāṃ apasmāya namaḥ । kaniṣṭhikāyāṃ oṃ anādaye namaḥ । (l.5) dakṣiṇorūmūle oṃ nānānānāya namaḥ । jānuni dhūdhūdhūdhū namaḥ । jaṅghāyām oṃ bhūḥ namaḥ
(p.52a, f.47b, l.1) pādatale oṃ bhuva namaḥ । pṛṣṭhe oṃ suvannamaḥ । aṅguṣṭhe oṃ anidhanāya namaḥ । tarjanyāṃ oṃ nidhanāya namaḥ । (l.2) madhyamāṅguḻyāṃ oṃ nidhanodbhavāya namaḥ । anāmikāyām oṃ śivāya namaḥ । kaniṣṭhikāyām oṃ śarvāya namaḥ (l.3) vāmorumūle oṃ paramātmane namaḥ । jānuni oṃ maheśvarāya namaḥ ।(l.4) jaṅghāyām oṃ mahādevāya namaḥ । pādatale oṃ sadbhāveśvarāya namaḥ । pādatalapṛṣṭhe mahātejase namaḥ । (l.5) aṅguṣṭhe oṃ yogādhipataye namaḥ । tarjanyāṃ oṃ muñca muñcāya namaḥ । madhyamāṅgulyām oṃ prathama prathamāya namaḥ ।
(p.52b, f.48a, l.1) anāmikāyāṃ oṃ sarvassarvāya namaḥ । kaniṣṭhikāyāṃ oṃ bhavabhavāya namaḥ । vāmamūrddhni oṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ (l.2) vāmaśrotre oṃ sarvabhūtasukhapradāya namaḥ । vāmāṃse oṃ sarvasānnidhyakarāya namaḥ । (l.3) vāmapārśve oṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrarūpāya namaḥ । vāmakaṭisthale oṃ anarcitanarcitāya namaḥ । (l.4) dakṣiṇakaṭisthale oṃ asaṃstuta asaṃstutāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇapārśve oṃ pūrvasthitapūrvasthitāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇāṃse oṃ sākṣin sākṣine namaḥ । (l.5) dakṣiṇaśrotre oṃ turu turu namaḥ । dakṣiṇamūrddhni oṃ pataṅga pataṅgāya namaḥ । nābhau oṃ piṅga piṅgāya namaḥ ।
(p.53a, f.48b, l.1) pṛṣṭhe oṃ jñāna jñānāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇapāde oṃ śabdaśabdāya namaḥ । vāmapāde sūkṣma sūkṣmāya namaḥ । (l.2) dakṣiṇoru oṃ śivāya namaḥ । vāmorū oṃ sarvāya namaḥ । nāsikāyāṃ oṃ sarvadāya namaḥ । (l.3) mūrddhni oṃ namaśśivāya namaḥ । dakṣiṇahaste oṃ namo namaḥ । vāmahaste oṃ śivāyanamonamaḥ evaṃ ekāśitipadāni vinnyaset - (l.4) mūrddhnī oṃ hoṃ īśānamūrddhāya namaḥ । vaktre oṃ heṃ tatpuruṣavaktrāya namaḥ । (l.5) hṛdaye oṃ huṃ aghorahṛdayāya namaḥ । guhye oṃ hīṃ vāmadevaguhyāya namaḥ । pādau oṃ haṃ sadyojātamūrtaye namaḥ ।
(p.53b, f.49a, l.1) hṛdaye oṃ hāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ । śirasī oṃ hīṃ śirasesvāhā । śikhāyāṃ oṃ hūṃ śikhāyaivaṣaṭ । (l.2) sthanamadhye oṃ haiṃ kavacāya huṃ । netre oṃ hauṃ netrebhyovauṣaṭ । (l.3) dikṣu oṃ haḥ astrāya phaṭ itimantrāḥ । ṣaḍoddhvā samāptaḥ - । (l.4) oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvāya namaḥ ātmatattvādhipāyai oṃ hāṃ kriyāśaktaye namaḥ ityādhobhāge । (l.5) oṃ hīṃ vidyātattvāya namaḥ vidyātattvādhipāyai oṃ hīṃ jñānaśaktyau namaḥ iti madhyabhāge । oṃ hūṃ śivatattvāya namaḥ śivatattvādhipāyai oṃ hūṃ icchāśaktyai namaḥ ityūrdhvabhāge ।
